what_it_does: Improves training efficiency of large language models on long text sequences by reducing memory consumption during pipeline parallelism. Pipeline parallelism distributes layers of a model across multiple processors to speed training, but saving intermediate outputs (activations) for gradient computation becomes expensive with long sequences. SlimPipe partitions the input sequence into smaller uniform chunks and reorganizes the pipeline schedule (1F1B means one forward pass then one backward pass per device) with workload rebalancing. This reduces memory pressure and improves overall throughput efficiency.
